suggested_ig_names.ig_devout: Cult of the Lady (Damsels and Grail Pilgrims)

baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e Bretonnia army book; WH: The Old World (2023+) Bretonnia background (knightly caste over peasant serfs, Lady of the Lake, dukes and barons)
baseline.why: Hereditary knightly warrior caste over bound peasants, hereditary feudal offices, the Lady as state cult, land tax, guilds only in the port cities, and knights' disdain for gunpowder (tier 5)

greenskin_holdout.source: canon: WFB 8e Orcs & Goblins army book (Warboss-led mobs, Gork and Mork shamans, goblins bullied by orcs); TW:WH3 greenskin tribes
greenskin_holdout.why: A greenskin horde is run by the strongest Warboss with shamans of Gork and Mork; no bureaucracy or schooling, tribute taxed at the mob's pleasure, captives and goblins enslaved

wood_elf_realm.source: canon: WFB 8e Wood Elves army book (Athel Loren and the Asrai enclaves ruled by Glade Lords and Spellweavers, closed to outsiders); TW:WH2 Wood Elves
wood_elf_realm.why: Secretive forest realms: warrior-caste Glade Guard, no trade or migration, little taxation, no slavery, no schooling beyond the Spellsingers' lore; held at tier 6 as the mod's lowest elven rung (no industry)
